newsitem.title: UK: Odds shorten on Labour victory in UK election.
newsitem.headline: Odds shorten on Labour victory in UK election.

text.p: The odds on Britain's opposition Labour Party winning an imminent general election shortened on Saturday after a flurry of bets, bookmakers William Hill said.

The firm said it put the odds on Labour grabbing power from the ruling Conservatives after 18 years in opposition at 1-7, making it "the hottest favourite to win a general election since they lost power."

The bookmaker said that in the past week it had received scores of bets of up to 25,000 pounds ($40,000) on Labour winning the election, expected to be called for May 1, but only one gambler had bet 1,000 pounds or more on the Conservatives winning.

The favourite outcome for the election was for Labour to win between 365 and 369 seats in the House of Commons (lower house) which will have 659 seats after the election, William Hill said in a statement. ($1=.6228 Pound)
